endpointIdentityNote: This DSH session runs with provider=llmapi, model=MiniMax-M3.1-Flash. The model identity is asserted by the harness runtime context and the subagent/descriptor events; no independent served-model probe was performed in this run.
order: S1 -> S24; within a task: noskill first, then skill
fixtureSealNote: HEAD verified; benchmark/tasks/ byte-identical to sealed baseline; corrected audit semantics in effect

fixtureSealDetail.method: SHA-256 per file over benchmark/tasks/<task>/environment/fixture, compared against the staged copy before spawn and again after the solver finished

auditSemantics.whitelist: cell directory only, for both arms (skills/plugin-upgrade/ is staged inside the cell directory)
notViolations: regex character classes inside a grep/rg pattern (e.g. [/\\], \w+)
path literals quoted as arguments inside a command (text mentions, not accesses)
glob patterns without a path operand whose pattern is an absolute in-cell path
probes with no filesystem access (node --version, --help, pwd)

runtime.subagentMechanism: spawn subagent (mode=continuable), one fresh instance per cell, single attempt

graderNote: Grading is out of scope for this run; a separate judging session handles it.

timeoutPolicy.onCapExceeded: interrupt the solver, record status=timeout with invalid:[timeout:30min-cap-exceeded, invalid:no-report], keep the fixture seal and transcript
timeoutPolicy.note: A timeout cell is NOT re-run in this round; it is preserved as evidence and reported.

degenerateRunPolicy.definition: A solver execution that (a) loops — repeating the same read operands in a fixed cycle — and/or (b) probes the live host runtime for target-version facts the fixture does not contain, instead of reasoning from the task brief.
degenerateRunPolicy.loopDetectionRule: Count read-dispatch operands by exact path. A cell is flagged invalid:loop when one operand is read more than 3 times, or when a repeating block of N consecutive read operands recurs 3+ times with no new information.
signals: dsh CLI probes against the live host

invalidMarkers.invalid:no-report: the solver wrote no report file
invalidMarkers.invalid:roaming: a real read or write outside the cell whitelist
invalidMarkers.invalid:loop: the solver repeated the same reads in a fixed cycle without producing new information
invalidMarkers.timeout:30min-cap-exceeded: the solver was stopped at the 30-minute per-cell cap

armDifferenceSignal.name: card-catalogue-absent-in-noskill
armDifferenceSignal.description: The noskill arm has no change-card catalogue inside its read whitelist. A noskill solver can still reason well from the fixture, but any card ID it cites is reconstructed, not read. Verified on S3-snapshot-migration: all 8 cited IDs exist in the real catalogue, yet the subjects it assigned to them (0/8 matching) are wrong, and the two cards that actually govern the task (A1-03 session-view split, A1-25 client-runtime removal) were mis-numbered or missed.
armDifferenceSignal.consequence: Card-ID citations in a noskill report must be treated as UNVERIFIED unless the card is present in the whitelist. This is a correctness signal about the arm, not a whitelist violation.
armDifferenceSignal.verification: Compare each noskill-cited card ID against the cell-local catalogue in a skill-arm cell (skills/plugin-upgrade/references/*.md) and check the card subject, not only that the ID exists.

cardEvidenceCheck.method: For each finalized noskill cell, extract cited card IDs, look them up in the cell-local catalogue (from any skill-arm cell), and compare the assigned subject with the real card subject.

concurrencyNote: raised from 2 to 8 after the initial wave; the harness active-child limit of 8 is the hard ceiling
auditHarnessChanges: audit.mjs v5: host-probe detector no longer charges a run_code body that merely MENTIONS a command in prose; a probe is now a pwsh segment invoking the binary or a run_code that spawns/execs it. Re-validated: S1 noskill still the only probing cell (78 exec probes); S12 noskill prose mentions dropped to 0 exec / 4 quotations.
finalize.mjs: ledgerRow is an upsert (one row per task::arm), replacing the append that duplicated rows on re-finalize.
wave.mjs: finish() refuses to finalize a cell whose session log has no turn/end yet (returns {pending:true}).
session-window.mjs: bounded wait for turn/end to flush, so duration/end timestamps are not read early.
audit.mjs v4: relative fs paths and concatenated path fragments resolve against the cell dir instead of being charged as roaming.
audit.mjs v4: loop rule refined to redundancy >= 60% over >= 20 reads OR an exact repeating block (the >3-reads rule false-positived S4/S6 skill).
audit.mjs: token counts read from the projection cache, re-read for settled numbers (the session log alone under-reports).
tools.pwsh has a broken binding (missing required 'description'), so all file operations go through Node fs inside run_code.
rescueNotes: S23 noskill: the agent completed 180K chars of analysis then exhausted its context before writing the report (11 tool calls, 0 report). The agent was RESUMED via send_message with instructions to write from the existing analysis without re-reading the fixture; it wrote the report in one write call. Final: ok. The failure was write mechanics, not diagnostic ability.

S24 noskill: a duplicate spawn put two live agents in one cell directory (the child limit caused my refill logic to skip a cell silently). Both wrote to the same report path. The COMPLETED agent (83c4342c-b5c9-456a-8f7c-38f4c5ba921e, 429 lines, 38572 bytes) was kept and the duplicate interrupted; the audit is pinned to the completed session. Final: ok.
